{{Top|leg}}
'''Surveyor Hall''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thrantin]]. It was used by the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]] and had at least four conference rooms. Master [[Barosa Warren]] held his introductory statements to newly arrived students at Surveyor Hall.
